params.query: employee manager reporting hierarchy head of retail

params.sql: select role, channel_code, count(*) n from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.employees` where rn = 1 and coalesce(is_deleted,false) = false group by 1,2 order by 1,2
select table_name, column_name from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where regexp_contains(lower(column_name), r'manager|report|supervisor|parent|lead|boss|head')

select employee_id, employee_name, role, channel_code from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.employees` where regexp_contains(lower(concat(ifnull(role,''),' ',ifnull(employee_name,''))), r'head|retail|director|vp|chief')

params.content:
## Employee data has no reporting hierarchy

- `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.employees` holds employee_id, employee_name, role, channel_code, store_id, hire_date and employment_status. It has **no manager_id / reports_to column**.
- No column anywhere in `dev_dna_silver` matches manager/report/supervisor/parent/head (checked via INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS). The only near-match is suppliers.avg_lead_time_days, which is unrelated.
- There are no executive roles. Current roles (rn=1, not deleted) are: Barista, Cafe Manager, Cashier, Customer Success Rep, Dark Store Ops Lead, Export Ops Coordinator, Marketplace Account Manager, Picker, Sales Associate, Store Manager. No "Head of Retail" exists.
- So org-chart questions such as "how many people report to X" cannot be answered from this warehouse.

Source: a user asked "How many people ultimately report to the head of retail?" on 2026-10-08.
